recommendations.statement: In the FLEX table, 55 of 58 tests at 12 to 16 % O2 ended in extinction (95 %). At 12 and 13 % O2, all 17 tests ended in extinction. Lower ambient O2 favoured extinction in this campaign.
recommendations.evidence: processed psi69_all_burns.csv, extinction share by O2 bin
recommendations.not_for: Crew habitats. Lowering O2 is not a habitat recommendation.

recommendations.statement: At 25 % O2 and above, extinction was rare: 2 of 30 tests (7 %). Most tests at these levels were disruptions (no clean outcome). The 30 % bin had 2 extinctions of 15 tests.
recommendations.evidence: raw FLEX table, Test end by O2
recommendations.confidence: Low: small counts and many disruptions

recommendations.statement: A logistic model on O2, pressure, droplet size and fuel does not beat predicting the majority class (accuracy 0.875 vs 0.873). Use it only as a descriptive tool.
At 20 cm/s, the opposed-flow record spread slower than the two concurrent-flow records (1.3 vs 1.8 and 2.1 mm/s).
For sensor alarms, require the sample thermocouple to confirm an alarm from another channel within 15 s. Radiation and plume channels alarmed in Sample 2 without sample heating.
recommendations.not_for: Final alarm logic. Needs repeat runs.

recommendations.statement: No extinction threshold exists for lunar gravity in the loaded records. Do not extrapolate from microgravity or 1 g.
